normalizations.name: scalar_ids_to_strings
normalizations.source_behavior: Scalar identifiers may retain heterogeneous JSON scalar types.
normalizations.target_behavior: Every nonempty string, integer, float, or boolean identifier is normalized deterministically to a string; collisions are rejected.
normalizations.semantic_reason: Stable joins and serialized identities must not depend on input scalar type.

normalizations.name: strict_line_local_utf8_jsonl
normalizations.source_behavior: The source loader accepts permissive whole-file object or array JSON shapes.
normalizations.target_behavior: Each nonblank physical UTF-8 line must contain exactly one example object; arrays, wrappers, and pretty-printed whole-file objects are rejected.
normalizations.semantic_reason: The standalone CLI has one explicit, streaming-safe external input contract.

normalizations.name: strict_verifier_shape
normalizations.source_behavior: Malformed verifier data may be treated as an empty object.
normalizations.target_behavior: Verifier decisions require an explicit boolean validity value; later method code records parse failures rather than coercing truthiness.
normalizations.semantic_reason: Verification state remains typed and auditable.

normalizations.name: provider_errors_are_explicit
normalizations.source_behavior: Provider failures may be swallowed and represented as an empty response.
normalizations.target_behavior: Transport, timeout, HTTP, envelope, and content failures raise ProviderError without implicit retry.
normalizations.semantic_reason: A failed provider call cannot be mistaken for a semantic model response.

normalizations.name: source_context_alias
normalizations.source_behavior: One historical label uses api-only punctuation.
normalizations.target_behavior: The public context is api_only; the historical spelling is documentation-only and is not accepted by runtime validation.
normalizations.semantic_reason: All four public context names use one underscore convention.
